question: Question
defaultDirections: Select the answer you feel answers the question. When you are done, press {checkAnswer}. You will get feedback indicating correctness of your answer and how to proceed.
relatedContentDescription: This creates a collapsed area for content related to this question and is always shown
hintDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer wrong
evidenceDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer correct
flagDirections: Pick a flag, then select each {unit} or figure in the reading that is evidence for it. Select a flag in the margin to remove it. When you are done, press {checkAnswer}.
selectOneDirections: Select the {unit} that best answers the question, then press {checkAnswer}.
holding: Holding {flag}. Select where it belongs. Escape puts it back.
pickAFlag: Pick a flag, then select where it belongs.
editHint: Edit the reading below. Use Mark answers in the block menu to choose where each flag belongs.
markingHint: Marking answers: pick a flag, then select each place it belongs. Learners never see this layer.
noTargets: Add a reading with paragraphs or figures to this block.
